description:
Invoke function getMicrosoft365CopilotUserCountTrend

TIP: Gets the Microsoft 365 Copilot user count trend (time series) over a period (D7/D28/D90/D180/ALL; D30 belongs to report version v1). Microsoft now serves report version v2 by default; leave the optional version parameter unset. Returns one data point per day with active counts per app. Use for trend reporting (week-over-week adoption growth, post-training adoption bump, Friday usage drop, etc.). Pair with get-copilot-user-count-summary (snapshot) for full adoption picture.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

name: get-copilot-user-count-trend
